title: PR8043 Staging one-click runtime-state and access-repair convergence

phases.objective: Reconcile Staging one-click tunnel lifecycle authority and local access-repair handoff while preserving fail-closed Production, provider, database, grant, and Breakglass boundaries.

e2e_journeys.actor: Staging operator through governed one-click and recovery surfaces
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Evaluate the exact PR head with local Staging runtime defaults, exact-commit topology-transition authority, and server-derived access-repair handoff.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Staging tunnel authority is published only after exact-commit proof, access-repair handoff is reproducible from server-derived evidence, and no Production, provider, database, grant, or Breakglass mutation is authorized by this PR.
steps: Default the normal launcher path to disabled local-only mode unless activation is explicitly enabled.
Bind topology-transition authority and bounded deployment lease to the exact repository commit before publishing tunnel state.
Fail closed when runtime commit evidence does not equal the expected topology-transition commit.
Produce and verify a deterministic Staging local access-repair request bound to canonical plan and request digests.
Keep apply_grants behind its separate execution ticket, typed confirmation, server reservation, and same-cycle readback authority.
Require live Staging certification before any promotion decision affecting the shared runtime.
assertions: The environment impact declaration is bound to the canonical deployment branch policy.
Shared-runtime impact is explicitly declared for both staging and production and cross-environment review is true.
No Production deploy, Cloudflare/provider mutation, database/schema/grant mutation, or Breakglass execution is introduced or authorized by this declaration.
The historical access-repair plan is evidence only and is not reusable execution authority.
